summary: PBX Phase 3 + Lost-6 backend testing (9/9 pytest passed). Covered: phone-lookup (400 on <4 digits, unknown→kind:null, member match), chat/users staff-only + excludes self, config-bundle extensions.conf renders GotoIfTime(09:00-17:00,mon&tue&wed&thu&fri,*,*?tc-0-active) plus override Dial line, campus switcher PUT (admin any-campus, non-admin 403 on unassigned top-level campus, 200 on assigned), admin /users/directory STAFF_ROLES filter + include_all gating.

minor.issue: Returned `kind` field is computed as `link_route.strip('/').rstrip('s')`. For collection 'members' the link_route is 'people' — `.rstrip('s')` does NOT strip the trailing 'e', so kind comes back as 'people' instead of 'member'. Same for 'guests'→'people'→'people' (loses the 'guest' semantic). The review request explicitly stipulates kind='member' for member matches. Suggested fix: derive kind from the collection name (e.g. `coll.rstrip('s')` where coll='members'→'member', 'guests'→'guest', 'users'→'user', 'families'→'familie' (so use a static map: members→member, users→user, guests→guest, families→family). Frontend screen-pop toast & navigation logic in BrowserSoftphone.jsx may key off `kind` for icon/label — verify and adjust together.

action_items: Fix /api/pbx/phone-lookup `kind` field: replace `link_route.strip('/').rstrip('s')` with an explicit collection→singular map ({'members':'member','users':'user','guests':'guest','families':'family'}). Verify BrowserSoftphone.jsx screen-pop still matches expected kind values after the fix.

rca of the issue: phone-lookup kind bug: `link_route.rstrip('s')` was written assuming routes always end in 's' (and the singular is just route minus s). But the route table is `('members','people')`, `('guests','people')`, `('users','admin/users')` — only the collection names are plurals. Operating on link_route was the wrong variable choice.
